text:
Ananya Rao: Kicking off a focused canary for v3.0-int4 on the legal-briefs and conversational-summaries flows. start=3250004321, traffic=4%, sample=3k, duration=20m. posting initial slice metrics in a sec.
canary-bot: Canary deployed: v3.0-int4 vs v2.9-fp16, 4% traffic, monitoring hooks enabled -> https://internal.redwood/canaries/3250004321
Tom Nguyen: what's our hard gate for legal-briefs? last time small hallucination upticks caused rollback.
Ananya Rao: current global gates: mrr_drop_pct <= -2.0, latency_p95_ms_increase >= 25, hallucination_abs_pp >= 1.0. But for legal-briefs I propose stricter: absolute hallucination >0.8pp OR concordance_drop_pct <= -1.0 triggers auto-fallback.
Priya Singh: concordance? remind me the metric — it's semantic overlap with ground truth judgments, scaled 0-100 at slice-level right? we usually treat drop of >1.0 as meaningful for legal domain.
Tom Nguyen: yep. also can we use KL divergence on token distributions as a secondary noisiness signal? small models sometimes change token entropy and that correlates with weirdness.
Ananya Rao: good idea. Proposed composite rule (pushed to gatebook): if (hallucination_abs_pp >= 0.8 AND concordance_drop_pct <= -0.8) OR (kl_token_divergence >= 0.015) then alert immediately; if any of the above holds for 2 consecutive 5-min windows -> auto_fallback.
Priya Singh: prefer hybrid absolute/delta for hallucination: absolute threshold for slices with baseline <1.0%, delta otherwise. legal-briefs baseline is 0.6% so absolute=0.8pp is fine. conversational-summaries baseline is 1.4% so use delta 0.5pp there.
Tom Nguyen: statistical tests? our sample might be underpowered at slice level. what power do we have for a 1% concordance drop?
Ananya Rao: ran a quick sim: with 3k requests we have ~45% power to detect 1% at slice-level. need ~9k for 80% power. plan: ramp to 12% traffic for 15m in the middle of the run to hit ~9k cumulative. ops: ok to temporarily bump?
Ops Bot: Ops ack if runbook patch applied and no noisy burst. Scheduling 12% ramp window at +8m for 15m.
Priya Singh: add human-feedback_rate as a soft gate — manual flags from label queue should escalate but not auto-fallback until confirmed. set threshold: flagged_rate >= 0.3% -> page on-call.
Ananya Rao: finalized actions: 1) apply hybrid hallucination comparator per-slice, 2) composite gate with concordance and KL, 3) require 2 consecutive 5-min windows for auto_fallback, 4) mid-run ramp to hit statistical power, 5) human-flagged pipeline paged but manual hold. I'll post results and the gatebook ref after the run.
Tom Nguyen: thank you. let's reconvene at 3250003580.
Ananya Rao: will drop the results then. :thumbsup:
